world_atmosphere.amber_dunes: The sands test your endurance. Ancient ruins rise from the dunes; every grain of detail matters.
world_atmosphere.crystal_depths: Beneath the surface, coral bridges wind between luminous forms. Hold your breath and read the current.
world_atmosphere.aurora_peaks: The cold thins your thoughts. Aurora bands drift across peaks of ice — sharp, quiet, unforgiving.
world_atmosphere.inferno_core: The core burns. Obsidian pillars lean over lava rivers; only the sharpest minds make it through.
